values.note: DCNR state forest motorized campsite rate (a state forest program, not a state park one). The $6.50 reservation fee is non-refundable and charged once per booking.

fees.source: ReserveAmerica's price block for one night (read 2026-11-10): PA residents $10.00 a night ($70.00 a week), non-residents $15.00 a night ($105.00 a week), 'Reservation Fees $6.50', and 'Any applicable taxes will be shown within the shopping cart' (the cart needs a login and was not opened). https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/what-to-do/stay-overnight/overnight-prices-and-policies ('Motorized roadside, hike-in roadside, equestrian, and rustic campsites can be reserved for a fee of $10.00 a night for Pennsylvania residents and $15.00 a night for non-residents ... effective as of November 3, 2022'); Michaux camping brochure, elibrary.dcnr.pa.gov docId 3562328 ('DCNR charges a $6.50 non-refundable transaction fee on all reservations and registrations')

values.note: Check-in and check-out are 3 pm. After a stay, 48 hours off state forest land before camping again.

note: A log landing at the edge of a timber-harvest clearing, set about 80 m back from Broad Mountain Road on its own track, a quarter mile north of One Mile Trail; open to the sun and out of sight of the road. The booking page calls it a grass parking area for 'one small camper trailer' while its attributes say gravel: imagery shows a pale bare patch about 20 m by 15 m, so expect grass and dirt that may be soft when wet. Back-in. Gravel forest road all the way in: about 4.5 miles from Upper Strasburg Road by Bear Valley Road and Broad Mountain Road. No toilet; pack out trash. State forest roads get no winter maintenance and are not plowed. --Claude
summary: Site page re-read: still listed and bookable online, Drive-In, RV/Tent/Trailer categories, max vehicle length 40 ft, back-in, 275-ft driveway. Fees confirmed and the $6.50 reservation fee added; booking, hookups, season confirmed; pull_through set false; toilets/water written as none. Imagery: bare landing at the edge of a clearcut, pin within about 10 m of it, reached by a track from the road. NHD: no water within 200 m. Phone 717-485-3148 confirmed.
flags: Site text: ReserveAmerica says 'Grass parking area that can hold 1 small camper trailer or 2 vehicles with tents' (the DCNR GIS layer, last edited 2022, says '1 camper trailer of any size'). 'Small' is not a length and the page still lists RV Site with a 40-ft maximum, so no drop is proposed; the wording is in the note.

Surface conflict on the agency's own page: attribute 'Driveway Surface: Gravel' but description 'Grass parking area'. Imagery shows bare ground, not a built gravel pad; the note carries a soft-ground caveat.
